$comment: Parity ledger against upstream BigCommerce Catalyst (core). `baseline` is the release this repo was built from. Every changelog entry since then gets a decision keyed by its PR number, so `pnpm parity` only reports what is still undecided. Statuses: ported | not-applicable | pending.

3170.note: Cloudflare Workers KV adapter — lib/kv/adapters/cloudflare-kv.ts, selected in createKVAdapter via CATALYST_ROUTES_KV.

3209.note: Date option earliest/latest/limitDateBy — domain/product-options.ts maps bounds, option-fields renders native min/max. Upstream also validates client-side only.

3221.note: X-Correlation-ID poisoning the Next Data Cache. This repo sends no correlation header and caches with `use cache` over `fetch(no-store)`, so the Data Cache key is never involved.

3215.note: proxies/with-ucp-proxy.ts (first in the chain) + lib/ucp/upstream.ts; header allow-lists kept verbatim. Matcher adds /api/ucp/:path*. Verified live: responses match BigCommerce's direct responses.

3231.note: lib/auth/session-token-cookie-options.ts + patchSessionTokenCookies wrapping signIn in lib/auth/index.ts. Also closes the pre-existing 1.11.0 gap (session token was a 30-day persistent cookie).

3194.note: Upstream's reusable GitHub Actions preview-deployment workflow for its own monorepo; no storefront behaviour.
